indicator_name: Damu Fund: loans approved for interest-rate subsidy by approval month (from 2024), region and programme
description: Фонд «Даму»: кредиты, одобренные к субсидированию ставки, по месяцам одобрения (с 2024 г.), регионам и программам
methodology: As DAMU_SUBSIDISED_LOANS_ANNUAL, for the projects whose approval month is given (all projects from 2024; none before). Items TOTAL, COUNT.TOTAL, PROG.*, SIZE.*. The current month is incomplete until the next edition. Edition as of 2026-09-01: 120429 projects.
